اندرجوا (form VII)
# اِنْدَرَجُوا (indarajū) /in.da.ra.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْدَرَجَ (indaraja)
# اِنْدَرِجُوا (indarijū) /in.da.ri.d͡ʒuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْدَرَجَ (indaraja)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
